conclusion: Reject the prediction-quality premise for this switch. It changes storage/conversion placement, not the information stored. Do not launch a compression run under the claim that this switch restores value precision.
mechanism: Change only AttnKind::KVI8 to the existing AttnKind::KVF32 as a supposed removal of lossy value-cache quantization.
not_rejected: A separately specified model retaining prequantization activations, retraining, or measured runtime-only layout optimization is a different hypothesis.
premise_test: Both insert overloads receive already quantized int8 K and V. KVF32 sign-extends V to int32 then exactly converts those same integers to float32. It does not retain prequantization V or recover lost precision.
proof_scope: All int8 values are exactly representable in float32. The two layouts retain the same discrete values; this source inspection does not independently certify bit-identical whole-model arithmetic or a runtime improvement.
